hudson.tasks.Shell.command: set -e echo "Building shop-api release $RELEASE" for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "compiling module $i/5 ... ok"; done echo "Running 128 unit tests" if [ "$PROFILE" = "tax-v2" ]; then echo "tests/test_checkout.py::test_total_with_tax FAILED" echo "AssertionError: checkout total wrong: expected 105.00, got 100.00" echo "ERROR: 1 failed, 127 passed" exit 1 fi if [ "$PROFILE" = "publish-only" ]; then echo "Publishing image registry.local/shop-api:$RELEASE" echo "ERROR: authentication required: registry credentials REGISTRY_TOKEN not set" exit 2 fi echo "128 passed" echo "Published registry.local/shop-api:$RELEASE"
